Chapter 2.52
PERSONNEL SYSTEM
2.52.010
Regulations and benefits.
Unless otherwise provided by law or contract, officers and employees of the city are
govermed by the city personnel (employee) rules and regulations on file in the offices of human
resources and the city clerk.
A.
Changes to the city personnel (employee) rules and regulations shall be in
accordance with the Wyoming Administrative Procedure Act, Wyo.Stat. Sections 16-3-101, et
seq.
B.
(employee)rules and regulations must be filed with and pursuant to established procedures of
Chapter 2.92, Administrative Hearing Procedure. This procedure does not apply to grievance
procedures prior to an appeal.
